title: Our 2.5D Online Pixel RPG - Lumoria
author: AkiraVero
selftext:
Hi Everyone!

My fiancee and I are building a cozy and competitive Online Pixel RPG using AI tools to assist us. We are combining the type of games that we both love to play.

We are looking for some feedback on how the visuals / gameplay and trailer looks. The trailer was made with the help of Opus 5.5 mainly doing all the work putting the scenes together for us.

First impressions? Thoughts on what could be improved or changed? From first glance does it look like something you would be interested in playing?

**How we build it with Claude:** We use Claude Code with Opus 5.5 for much of the day-to-day mundane work. I use agents to assist me in writing the code (game server, combat, browser client, map tools, etc.), and run mundane tests / checks. My fiancee uses Claude agents to assist with art and review screenshots against our art rules. I also use Astra as a second critic / to review some of the work.

The website and Discord are a heavy WIP (many of the trailers / clips on the website are very outdated), we would love to have you join us and can answer questions there as well!

  
We have a short "showcase" demo dungeon coming out in a few days / week. I've shown a few screenshots of that below.

  
Thank you for looking!
